acceptance_criteria: Accepted raises move the stake 1→3→6→9→12.
Refusal awards the challenger the previous stake and closes the hand.
A draw closes the hand without changing scores.
A team at 11 accepts a three-point hand or declines and gives opponents one point.
A Truco request by a team at 11 ends the match for the opponents without inventing score changes.
An iron hand cannot be scored until the caller supplies an explicit outcome.
The match ends and caps the winning score at 12.
exercises.complexity: O(1) per score or wager transition.
